requests.reply: {"translations": ["A rainy harbor town. A police car is parked in front of an old clock shop.", "Senior Kaoru, the scene is here. The lock was still engaged."]}
{"translations": ["Hmm. So only one pocket watch was stolen?"]}
{"translations": ["The shopkeeper, old Mr. Takanashi, sits in his chair, staring at the floor."]}
{"translations": ["You've arrived, detectives. I'll say this first: don't touch anything without permission.", "Yes, Inspector. I'll be careful."]}
{"translations": ["Don't call me Inspector. Akira is fine. Especially in front of Ms. Takanashi."]}
{"translations": ["Understood, Akira-san"]}
{"translations": ["The elderly Takanashi slowly raised his head."]}
{"translations": ["Akira folded his umbrella and wiped up the water drops from the floor.", "Akira-san, please put your umbrella here."]}
{"translations": ["Hikaru, who did you ask to watch the office?"]}
{"translations": ["This is Nagi. I'm still a girl of eighteen, but I'm dependable. Please rest assured, Akira-san."]}
{"translations": ["That's a big help. They handle phone duty and paperwork too."]}
{"translations": ["Save the small talk for later. First, we start the questioning.", "Akira-san, may we hear from Takanashi-san first?"]}
{"translations": ["In a trembling voice, the old man answered that he had closed the shop at nine o'clock last night."]}
{"translations": ["My grandfather has been polishing only that clock for many years."]}
{"translations": ["Apparently Yuki hasn't been able to sleep since last night. Her fingertips have been trembling the whole time."]}
{"translations": ["Hikaru, how do you read these footprints?", "Akira-san, these aren't the culprit's. The shoes are too big."]}
{"translations": ["Hikaru's powers of observation are sharp. He's still a rookie, but he's second to none."]}
{"translations": ["Kaoru took off her glasses and slowly pressed the bridge of her nose."]}
{"translations": ["That watch is also a keepsake from my mother ▼", "Nagi came rushing in, clutching a wet umbrella."]}
{"translations": ["Breathless, she relayed the phone message."]}
{"translations": ["Akira-san, the forensic results are in. I'll share them with the senior officer right away."]}
{"translations": ["Let me hear it. ...Oh? The culprit is inside the shop."]}
{"translations":["The hand of the elderly Takanashi trembled slightly.","Outside the window, the rain grew even heavier."]}

translations.24: That watch is also a keepsake from my mother ▼

translations.28: Let me hear it. ...Oh? The culprit is inside the shop.
